frontmatter.title: Quantum physics for algorithm implementations
frontmatter.description: States, measurements, dynamics, channels, and the physical meaning of an algorithm's output.

children.value: Complete positivity ensures valid states even when the input is entangled with another system. Trace preservation retains total probability. A selected measurement branch can instead decrease the trace; that trace records the branch’s success probability.
